A Brief History
Started in 1951 by D.
We still deliver fresh Cornish Farm goods, but now we cover destinations all over the UK and Europe. While we specialise in refrigerated transport of perishable goods on timed deliveries, our diverse fleet of Flat-Bed Trailers, Curtain-Siders, Tankers, Bulk Tippers, and Refrigerated Trailers allows us to meet our customers’ ever changing needs.
We pride ourselves in delivering a quality of service and reliability which you simply will not find from other companies.
We will deliver any load from a few pallets to a long term commitment delivering numerous loads every day.
The modern fleet which is now made up of DAFs, Scanias, and Volvos is still run from the same yard near Redruth, which has expanded overtime to house the ever-growing fleet.
The yard also accommodates our own highly experienced maintenance team, and an ATF lane making us truly self-sufficient.
Conway Bailey has grown into one of the largest independent haulers in the UK and we are still expanding our operations in order to provide our customers with a complete end-to-end service.

Our Transport Guarantee

Our General Haulage fleet is made up of flatbed trailers, 4 meter Euro-liners, as well as 4.2 and 4.5-meter curtain side trailers, allowing us to handle all manner of palletised and non-palletised goods.
We run an extensive range of temperature-controlled dual compartment and meat rail trailers. They can transport goods at any temperature from -25˚C to +20˚C. All our fridge trailers are ATP accredited enabling us to transport perishable goods throughout Europe and the UK with live temperature monitoring.
As with all our equipment, it is modern, serviced regularly, and the fridge units are temperature calibrated every 6 months.
Our fleet of vehicles and range of services wouldn’t be complete without bulk tippers. We have a fleet of TASCC registered tippers that run alongside our scrap and aggregate trailers, complimenting the rest of the CBT fleet perfectly.
All our Tankers are DTAS Registered. We specialize in carrying all types of perishable/non perishable food stuffs.
We can store over 5,000 pallets at any one time at any temperature between -25˚C to +20˚C.
From palletised fresh farm produce on our general haulage fleet, to local milk collection with our fleet of rigid tankers, we can provide our clients with a 1 stop shop service that complements our rural location perfectly.
We can offer a contract distribution service for businesses that wish to benefit from out-sourcing their transport requirements in order to concentrate on their core business, whilst still benefitting from the exposure that having a fleet of liveried trucks brings.
As a large independent haulier, it is imperative that we are as self-sufficient as possible, which is why we have an in-house training facility to provide CPC training and compliance updates to all our staff.
Authorised Testing Facility
We have our own ATF facility at our headquarters near Redruth. This facility is not only for our exclusive use, and test slots are available for anyone to book. Please call us and we can arrange your test for you.
